title: jmap: remove user_id from all mail queries
description:
## Why
After schema migration (oh45) and provision simplification (ycyh), every SQL query in the JMAP handlers that currently binds user_id needs to be updated. Also removes the cross-user access guard (AND user_id = ?) which is no longer meaningful.

## What

### email/get.rs
- fetch_smtp_emails_batch: remove user_id parameter and bind.
  Query becomes: SELECT id, raw_message, mailbox_id, received_at FROM messages WHERE id IN (...).
- handle_email_get: remove user_id parameter entirely.

### email/query.rs or server.rs Email/query arm
- EXISTS check: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mailboxes WHERE mailbox_id = ?). Drop user_id bind.
- COUNT query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE mailbox_id = ?. Drop user_id.
- Page query: SELECT id FROM messages WHERE mailbox_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?. Drop user_id.

### mailbox/provision.rs (list_mailboxes)
- list_user_mailboxes becomes list_mailboxes(pool) with no user_id param.

### session.rs (sieve_delivery Keep)
- INSERT into messages: drop user_id column and bind.
- SELECT for INBOX: SELECT mailbox_id FROM mailboxes WHERE role='inbox'. Drop JOIN on users table.

### email/types.rs (Email::from_smtp_message)
No change needed; mailbox_id is still passed as a parameter.

### Signature changes propagate to:
- mail/src/server.rs: drop user_id from all call sites
- mail/tests/*: update test fixtures and call sites

## Acceptance criteria
- No user_id variable or bind in any mail query.
- handle_email_get, fetch_smtp_emails_batch take no user_id.
- All tests pass.
